articles.title: Goldman Sachs to acquire ETF manager NEOS in $2.25B deal
articles.snippet: The deal would add NEOS’ $30 billion ETF business, including Bitcoin- and Ether-linked income funds, to Goldman Sachs Asset Management.

articles.title: Twitch Turns On Amazon AI Training by Default: 'Nobody Would Opt In'
articles.snippet: Twitch's chief product officer says he does not know whether content had already been used for training before the setting appeared.

articles.title: Fidelity Files to Let Its Ethereum ETF Stake and Pay Investors
articles.snippet: The Boston asset manager's FETH would stake up to 100% of its ETH and distribute the rewards to holders as quarterly cash, pending SEC approval.

articles.title: Harmony's ONE Sinks 37% After Attacker Mints 4 Billion Tokens
articles.snippet: The team is weighing a rollback, which would undo the attack along with every legitimate transaction made since.

articles.title: Ravencoin Crashes 20% as Critical Exploit Threatens to Rollback Network
articles.snippet: Two mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin's hash power are already rebuilding the chain from before Friday's first bad block—here's what a forced rollback would undo.
